reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Petition requirements, no joinder, and initial hearing
headings.reviewNote: Bars joining prohibition applications with other causes of action, requires a petition stating substantive facts, and provides for initial summary hearing or hearing upon notice ordered by the court or judge in vacation.

headings.title: Preliminary rule or order to show cause upon hearing
headings.reviewNote: Provides that if the petition is legally sufficient and supported by persuasive evidence, the court or judge in vacation may issue a preliminary rule or order to show cause and stay further action.

headings.title: Service of preliminary order and contempt penalties
headings.reviewNote: Directs service of the preliminary rule or order before the return day in the manner of civil process unless otherwise prescribed, and subjects disobedience to penalties of contempt.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all three subsections and history notes for 530.040. Corrected subsection 1 note to remove unsupported 'verified' requirement, aligned subsection 2 with 'preliminary rule or order', and added contempt penalties to subsection 3.
